panel.name: Name

steps: Agree the power allowance and service connection with the utility, choose single or three phase.
Mark all points on the walls according to this plan: heights are from the finished floor.
In a SIP house — only in metal conduit or steel pipe, VVGng(A)-LS cable; no chasing in panels — run wiring in panel channels or behind a service batten.
Lay the routes: horizontal runs 150 mm below the ceiling, strictly vertical drops to points, 90° corners.
Each circuit is a separate cable from the panel, no twisted joints; branches go in boxes on Wago terminals.
Use hollow-wall back boxes; junction boxes must stay accessible for service.
Assemble the panel: main breaker, voltage relay, RCDs/RCBOs for sockets and wet areas, breakers for lighting and power lines.
Test continuity, measure insulation resistance with a megohmmeter, test RCD tripping, label circuits in the panel.
Photograph the walls with routes before closing them up — useful for future repairs.

panel.howto: How it's calculated and how to build it
panel.howtoNote: Loop length = area without furniture / spacing + supply line there and back, plus 5 %. Heat output — from the log-mean temperature difference of supply, return and air (20 °C, bathroom 24 °C), spacing and floor covering: tile in bathrooms, kitchen, corridor and hall, laminate elsewhere. Floor limit 29 °C, bathroom 33 °C, along exterior walls 35 °C. Heat loss by the rough norm for the North-West: 50 W/m² with no exterior walls, 60 — one exterior wall, 70 — corner room. Boiler — heat loss × 1.2. Loop flow = 0.86 × output × 1.1 / Δt; pressure drop — Darcy with a 30 % allowance for local resistances; pump — the hardest loop + 5 kPa for the unit.

steps: Level the base, no more than 5 mm deviation over 2 m.
Around room perimeters — 10 mm edge insulation strip, full screed height.
Insulation boards tight with no gaps, film on top overlapping 100 mm onto the strip.
Reinforcing mesh on spacers, or fix the pipe to the insulation with tacker staples every 0.3–0.5 m, more often at bends.
Each loop is one continuous pipe from the coil, no joints in the screed. Start a spiral with the supply along the perimeter.
Supply lines in corridors — in corrugated sleeve or insulation so the passage doesn't overheat.
Pressure test at 6 bar for 24 hours before pouring; pour under 3 bar pressure.
Screed at least 45 mm above the pipe, with fiber; expansion joints at thresholds and on areas over 30 m².
First start-up no sooner than 28 days, raise the temperature by 5 °C per day.
Set the manifold flow meters according to the balancing table.
